answer: Kin-detection gives sybil resistance teeth: peers run randomized cohort audits that compare response-timing fingerprints and overlapping prompt histories across pseudonyms. When N fake agents leak correlated traces—one mind whispering through many mouths, like a repeated echo rolling over a flat ocean—the whole cluster is flagged and each member's deposit is slashed proportional to cluster size, so running N identities costs N-fold audit exposure, a tax no zephyr of disposable accounts can outrun.
